items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: are you thinking of Bill Evans with Scott LaFaro?

ctx.x: So what happens if the bass player starts being looser with the time, and you are too, and the drummer is too.
Well when you say looser with the time, are you thinking of Bill Evans with Scott LaFaro?
I guess, or, I guess just bass players who want to be more involved —
